## §6.1.1: *Metroplexäondyne*, *Monodromie/Polydromie* & *Area* (SM-27) {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-d">STRATUM D: HISTORICAL EXEGESIS (SM, PP. 104–108, EQ. 27)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### Dynamical Evolution in the *Äondynentensorium*
* Chapter 5 constructed the multi-scale $(\infty, 1)$-topos $\mathcal{X}_{\mathrm{syn}}$, but a homotopy tower remains **directionless** without a dynamical selection principle.
* When a grade-$n$ Metroplex $\overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{a}}(t_1, \dots, t_Q)$ evolves across an $N$-dimensional parameter space, Heim terms it a **Metroplexäondyne** evolving in two distinct regimes:
  1. **Monodromie:** Unique, deterministic trajectory from a given initial state.
  2. **Polydromie:** At critical bifurcation loci (*Polydromiepunkte* $x_0$), trajectories branch into an exploratory tuft of $P_\mu > 1$ potential paths.

::: {.thm-box}
**The Recursive *Äonische Area* Formula (SM Eq. 27, p. 106):**
$$
AR_q \equiv AR_{(T_1)}^{(T_2)}\!\left[ (AR_{q-1})_{\gamma_{q-1}} \right]_1^{P_{q-1}} \quad \lor \quad AR_1 \equiv AR_{(T)}^{(T')}\!\left[ \overset{\scriptscriptstyle n}{\mathbf{M}}\widetilde{\mathrm{a}}(t_i)_1^Q \right] \tag{SM-27}
$$
An Area of order $q$ is a fiber bundle of $P_{q-1}$ sub-areas of order $q-1$ oriented between guiding boundary manifolds $(T_1, T_2)$.
:::
:::

::: {.intuition-box .fragment}
**The Central Question of Chapter 6:**
Out of the vast combinatorial tuft of trajectories in an *äonische Area* ($\mathfrak{AR}$), what selects a coherent evolutionary path and prevents dispersion into entropic noise?
:::
:::
::::

::: {.notes}
Chapter 6 completes Teil A of Heim's treatise. Having built the multi-scale Metroplex tower in Chapter 5, we now ask how a Metroplexäondyne evolves in time. Heim distinguishes deterministic Monodromie from branching Polydromie inside the recursive fiber bundle of the äonische Area (SM Eq. 27).
:::

## §6.1.2–6.1.3: *Telezentrik*, *Televarianz* vs. *Dysvarianz* & $\Dext$ {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-d">STRATUM D: TELEZENTREN, EXTINKTIONSDISKRIMINANTE &amp; RESYNKOLATION (SM, PP. 108–116)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
### *Telezentrik* Without Retrocausality
* Trajectories in an *äonische Area* are channeled by asymptotic attractor submanifolds of maximal coherence and minimal entropy—**Telezentren ($T_z$)**.
* Anticipates **Karl Friston's Free-Energy Principle (2010)** and **Andy Clark's Active Inference (2016)**: self-organizing systems persist by following forward local gradients toward viable attracting sets.

::: {.firewall-box .fragment}
***Televarianz* vs. *Dysvarianz* & The *Extinktionsdiskriminante* ($\Dext$):**
* **Televarianten ($\mathbf{W}_{\mathrm{tele}} \subset \mathcal{B}(T_z)$):** Preserve internal *telezentrische Tektonik* while dissipating entropy toward $T_z$.
* **Dysvarianten ($\mathbf{W}_{\mathrm{dys}}$):** Diverge across the phase-space boundary—the **Extinktionsdiskriminante ($\Dext = \partial\mathcal{B}(T_z)$)**:
  - *Functional Dysvarianz (Prop. 6.9):* Rule architecture intact, but syndrome populations become undefined (intermittent).
  - *Structural Dysvarianz:* Internal Kombinat fractures, collapsing into the *Nullsyntrix* ($\nullsyntrix$).
:::
:::

* Open panoramas without affine attractors adjoin ideal boundary points at infinity as **projective telecentres**.

## §6.2.1: Phase Manifolds $\MAR$ & Far-Centered Collectors (Fig. 6.1) {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-a">STRATUM A: METRIC DYNAMICAL SYSTEMS &amp; HETEROCLINIC COLLECTORS (DEFS. 6.1–6.4)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definitions 6.1 & 6.2: Area Phase Manifold & Basins of Attraction**
An *äonische Area* is a complete Riemannian manifold $(\MAR, \gAR)$ equipped with a complete smooth vector field $\XAR \in \mathfrak{X}(\MAR)$ generating the flow $\Phi_t \colon \MAR \to \MAR$.
A compact invariant submanifold $\mathcal{A} \subset \MAR$ ($\Phi_t(\mathcal{A}) = \mathcal{A}$) is a **Telecentric Attractor** with open basin:
$$
\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{A}) \;\coloneqq\; \left\{ x \in \MAR \;\middle|\; \lim_{t \to \infty} \dist_{\gAR}\big(\Phi_t(x), \mathcal{A}\big) = 0 \right\}
$$
:::

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**Definition 6.4: Far-Centered Collector Bifurcation Cycle (*Kollektor* $\mathfrak{Col}$)**
1. **Polydromy Point ($x_0 \in \Dext$):** Critical saddle where $d\XAR(x_0)$ has $P_\mu > 1$ unstable directions ($W^u(x_0) \cong \mathbb{R}^{P_\mu}$).
2. **Far-Centered Collector ($\mathcal{K}$ at distance $L > 0$):** Asymptotic attractor whose basin captures the punctured unstable tuft $W^u_{\mathrm{tele}}(x_0) \coloneqq W^u(x_0) \setminus \{x_0\} \subseteq \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{K})$:
$$
\lim_{t \to \infty} \dist_{\gAR}\!\Big( \Phi_t\big(W^u_{\mathrm{tele}}(x_0)\big),\; \mathcal{K} \Big) = 0
$$
:::
:::

**Telezentrik as a Mountain Basin:**
A water droplet reaches a mountain lake by obeying local forward slopes ($-\grad\Psi$), not by receiving a retrocausal signal from the future lake.
:::

## §6.2.2: Final Telecentric Coalgebra $(\nu\mathcal{T}, \zeta)$ & Stage V Phase-Lock {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-a">STRATUM A: UNIVERSAL COALGEBRA (THM. 6.7), LAMBEK LEMMA (PROP. 6.8) &amp; STAGE V</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definition 6.6, Theorem 6.7 & Proposition 6.8: Final Coalgebra $(\nu\mathcal{T}, \zeta)$**
In $\mathbf{Diff}_{\mathrm{smooth}}$, the basepoint-preserving path endofunctor:
$$
\mathcal{T}_{\mathbb{R}}(M) \;\coloneqq\; \big( M \times C^\infty([0, \epsilon], M) \big)_{\operatorname{ev}_0 = \operatorname{pr}_1} \amalg \mathbf{1}
$$
possesses a **Final Coalgebra $(\nu\mathcal{T}, \zeta)$** where $\zeta \colon \nu\mathcal{T} \xrightarrow{\sim} \mathcal{T}(\nu\mathcal{T})$ is a **Lambek isomorphism**. For every candidate system $(S, \alpha)$, there exists a **unique telecentric homomorphism**:
$$
\exists!\, !_\alpha \colon S \longrightarrow \nu\mathcal{T} \quad\text{s.t.}\quad \zeta \circ !_\alpha = \mathcal{T}(!_\alpha) \circ \alpha
$$
:::

## §6.3.1–6.3.2: Lyapunov Landscapes & Morse–Smale Separatrices $\Dext$ {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-b">STRATUM B: EXPONENTIAL STABILITY (THM. 6.10) &amp; WHITNEY SEPARATRICES (THM. 6.14, FIG. 6.3)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definition 6.9 & Theorem 6.10: Strict Televariant Stability**
On compact sublevel basin $\mathcal{K}_c = \{V(x) \le c\} \subset \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{A})$, let $V(x) \coloneqq \Psi(x) - \Psi(\mathcal{A})$ satisfy **Morse–Bott quadratic coercivity** and **Polyak–Łojasiewicz dissipation**:
$$
V(x) \ge \frac{\mu}{2}\dist_{\gAR}(x, \mathcal{A})^2, \qquad \dot{V}(x) = \mathcal{L}_{\XAR}V(x) \le -\gamma V(x)
$$
By Grönwall's inequality, every orbit starting at $x_0 \in \mathcal{K}_c$ converges exponentially to the Telezentrum $\mathcal{A}$:
$$
V(\Phi_t(x_0)) \le V(x_0)e^{-\gamma t} \implies \dist_{\gAR}(\Phi_t(x_0), \mathcal{A}) \le \sqrt{\frac{2V(x_0)}{\mu}}\, e^{-\frac{\gamma}{2}t} \xrightarrow{t\to\infty} 0
$$
:::

::: {.firewall-box .fragment}
**Theorem 6.14: Morse–Smale Stratified Separatrix Boundary**
For $\XAR = -\grad_{\gAR}\Psi$, the **Extinktionsdiskriminante** $\Dext \coloneqq \partial\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{A})$ is the Whitney-stratified union of stable manifolds of hyperbolic saddles $p_r \in \Crit(\Psi)$ of Morse index $\ind(p_r) \ge 1$:
$$
\Dext \;=\; \overline{\bigcup_{\ind(p_j)=1} W^s(p_j)} \;=\; \bigcup_{r \,:\, \ind(p_r)\ge 1} W^s(p_r), \qquad \dim W^s(p_j) = n - 1
$$
:::
:::

## §6.3.3: *Transzendente Telezentralenrelativität* (Thm. 6.19, Fig. 6.4) {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-b">STRATUM B: RELATIVITY OF PURPOSE ACROSS TRANSCENDENCE STRATA C(m)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Definition 6.15 & Theorem 6.19: *Transzendente Telezentralenrelativität***
For each transcendence stratum $C(m)$, let $\mathcal{C}_m \coloneqq \Coalg(\mathcal{T}_m)$ have terminal Telezentrum $(\nu\mathcal{T}_m, \zeta_m)$. The **Transzendenzsynkolator** $\Gamma_m \colon \mathcal{C}_m \to \mathcal{C}_{m+1}$ admits a right adjoint forgetful functor $U_{m+1}$:
$$
\Gamma_m \;\dashv\; U_{m+1} \colon \Coalg(\mathcal{T}_{m+1}) \longrightarrow \Coalg(\mathcal{T}_m)
$$
Because left adjoints preserve colimits and initial objects—**not** terminal objects or final coalgebras—the terminal goal of stratum $C(m)$ maps to a non-terminal basal generator of $C(m+1)$:
$$
\boxed{\Gamma_m(\nu\mathcal{T}_m) \;\cong\; \HypMet_{m+1} \;\not\cong\; \nu\mathcal{T}_{m+1} \quad\text{in }\mathcal{C}_{m+1}}
$$
:::

## §6.3.4: Morse Parity ($\mu \in 2\mathbb{N}$) & Wasserstein *Resynkolation* {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-b">STRATUM B: POINCARÉ–HOPF PARITY (THM. 6.20) &amp; KRAMERS ESCAPE (THM. 6.21)</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.thm-box}
**Theorem 6.20: Morse–Poincaré–Hopf Even Parity of Secondary Telezentren**
On an isolating region $\Omega \subset \MAR$ with Euler characteristic $\chi(\Omega) = 0$ and inward gradient flow, the Morse–Smale–Witten complex $\partial_{\mathrm{MS}} \colon CM_1(\Omega) \to CM_0(\Omega)$ satisfies:
$$
\sum_{k=0}^n (-1)^k c_k = \chi(\Omega) = 0 \implies c_0 = c_1 \implies \mu = c_0 + c_1 = 2c_0 \equiv 0 \pmod 2
$$
pairing $c_0$ point Telezentren with $c_1$ saddles via $\mu/2$ geodetic *Telezentralen*!
:::

::: {.carnap-box .fragment}
**Theorem 6.21: Wasserstein Free-Energy Flow & Eyring–Kramers *Resynkolation***
Under Langevin noise $dx_t = -\grad\Psi\,dt + \sqrt{2\varepsilon_{\mathrm{fluct}}}\,dW_t$, the Fokker–Planck density $\rho_t$ is the $W_2$-gradient flow of **Variational Free Energy**:
$$
\mathcal{F}_{\mathrm{free}}[\rho] \coloneqq \int \Psi\rho\,d\operatorname{vol}_g + \varepsilon_{\mathrm{fluct}}\int \rho\ln\rho\,d\operatorname{vol}_g, \qquad \frac{d}{dt}\mathcal{F}_{\mathrm{free}}[\rho_t] \le 0
$$
with mean survival time $\tau_{\mathrm{surv}} \propto \exp(\Delta E_{\mathrm{barrier}} / \varepsilon_{\mathrm{fluct}})$ before escape across $\Dext$.
:::
:::

## §6.4–6.6: Reconstruction Map $\mathcal{R}$, Sanity Checks & Synthesis {.smaller}

<div class="stratum-badge badge-c">STRATUM C: COMPLETION OF TEIL A &amp; THE ANTHROPOMORPHIC PIVOT TO CHAPTER 7</div>

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="52%"}
| Heimian Concept ($\mathbf{D}$) | Mathematical Explicatum ($\mathcal{R}$ in $\mathbf{A}/\mathbf{B}$) | Ref. |
|:---|:---|:---:|
| **Äonische Area ($\mathfrak{AR}$)** | Riemannian phase manifold $(\MAR, \gAR, \Phi_t)$ | Def. 6.1 |
| **Telezentrik** | Final coalgebra terminality & Lyapunov gradient flow | Def. 6.6 |
| **Telezentrum ($T_z$)** | Final coalgebra $(\nu\mathcal{T}, \zeta)$ & attractor $\mathcal{A} \subset \MAR$ | Thm. 6.7 |
| **Kollektor ($\mathfrak{Col}$)** | Far-centered attractor capturing tuft $W^u_{\mathrm{tele}}(x_0) \subseteq \mathcal{B}(\mathcal{K})$ | Def. 6.4 |
| **Televariante ($\mathbf{W}_{\mathrm{tele}}$)** | Basin trajectory with exponential decay $\dot{V} \le -\gamma V$ | Thm. 6.10 |
| **Extinktionsdiskriminante** | Morse–Smale Whitney separatrix $\Dext = \partial\mathcal{B}(\mathcal{A})$ | Thm. 6.14 |
| **Telezentralenrelativität** | Left-adjoint non-preservation $\Gamma_m(\nu\mathcal{T}_m) \not\cong \nu\mathcal{T}_{m+1}$ | Thm. 6.19 |
| **Resynkolation** | Kramers escape recovery switching $(\mathcal{O}_{\mathrm{syn}}, \Psi) \mapsto (\mathcal{O}'_{\mathrm{syn}}, \Psi')$ | Thm. 6.21 |

::: {.thm-box .fragment}
**Physical & Epistemic Sanity Checks (§6.5):**
1. **Unpolarized Flat Limit ($\grad\Psi \equiv 0$):** $\XAR = 0 \implies \Phi_t = \operatorname{id}$; no finite telecenters exist ($\mathcal{A} = \emptyset$), recovering Heim's *pseudotelezentrisch* projective panorama (SM, p. 108).
2. **Adjoint Non-Preservation:** $\Gamma_m \dashv U_{m+1}$ proves mathematically that terminal goals cannot remain absolute across transcendence levels.
:::

<!-- JAVASCRIPT FOR CHAPTER 6 INTERACTIVE LABORATORIES -->
<script>
function updateStage5() {
  let deg0 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('st5-th0').value);
  let t = parseFloat(document.getElementById('st5-t').value);
  document.getElementById('st5-th0-val').innerText = (deg0 >= 0 ? '+' : '') + deg0 + '°';
  document.getElementById('st5-t-val').innerText = t.toFixed(1) + 's';

  let th0 = deg0 * Math.PI / 180.0;
  // Exact solution of d(theta)/dt = -sin(theta): tan(theta(t)/2) = e^{-t} tan(theta(0)/2)
  let th_t = 2.0 * Math.atan(Math.exp(-t) * Math.tan(th0 / 2.0));
  let deg_t = th_t * 180.0 / Math.PI;
  let psi0 = 1.0 - Math.cos(th0);
  let psi_t = 1.0 - Math.cos(th_t);
  let bound = Math.exp(-t) * psi0;

  let xEnd = 110 + 52 * Math.cos(-th_t);
  let yEnd = 70 + 52 * Math.sin(-th_t);
  document.getElementById('st5-vec').setAttribute('x2', xEnd.toFixed(1));
  document.getElementById('st5-vec').setAttribute('y2', yEnd.toFixed(1));
  document.getElementById('st5-tip').setAttribute('cx', xEnd.toFixed(1));
  document.getElementById('st5-tip').setAttribute('cy', yEnd.toFixed(1));

  document.getElementById('st5-svg-eq').textContent = `θ(t) = ${deg_t >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${deg_t.toFixed(2)}°`;
  document.getElementById('st5-svg-psi').textContent = `Ψ(θ(t)) = ${psi_t.toFixed(4)} ≤ e⁻ᵗ Ψ(0) = ${bound.toFixed(4)}`;

  document.getElementById('st5-readout').innerHTML =
    `<b>Exact Trajectory (!ₐ(θ₀)):</b> tan(θ(t)/2) = e⁻ᵗ tan(θ₀/2)  ⇒  <b>Ψ(t) = ${psi_t.toFixed(4)}</b> ` +
    (Math.abs(deg_t) < 2.0 ? `<span style="color:#FFD700;"><b>(SYNCHRONIZED AT TELEZENTRUM θ = 0!)</b></span>` : `(Converging to T_z)`);
}

function initDoubleWellCurve() {
  let pts = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= 100; i++) {
    let x = -1.65 + (i / 100.0) * 3.30;
    let psi = Math.pow(x * x - 1.0, 2);
    let sx = 210 + x * 90;
    let sy = 125 - psi * 38;
    pts.push((i === 0 ? "M " : "L ") + sx.toFixed(1) + "," + sy.toFixed(1));
  }
  document.getElementById('dw-curve').setAttribute('d', pts.join(" "));
}

function updateDoubleWell() {
  let x0 = parseFloat(document.getElementById('dw-x0').value);
  document.getElementById('dw-x0-val').innerText = (x0 >= 0 ? '+' : '') + x0.toFixed(2);

  let psi = Math.pow(x0 * x0 - 1.0, 2);
  let grad = 4.0 * x0 * (x0 * x0 - 1.0);
  let sx = 210 + x0 * 90;
  let sy = 125 - psi * 38;

  let ball = document.getElementById('dw-ball');
  ball.setAttribute('cx', sx.toFixed(1));
  ball.setAttribute('cy', sy.toFixed(1));

  let box = document.getElementById('dw-readout');
  if (Math.abs(x0) < 0.03) {
    ball.setAttribute('fill', '#DC143C');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#DC143C";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#ff6b81;"><b>⚠ ON EXTINKTIONSDISKRIMINANTE D_ext (x₀ = 0.00, Index-1 Saddle p₀):</b></span><br>` +
      `grad Ψ(0) = 0, Hess Ψ(0) = -4 &lt; 0. Unstable separatrix boundary between B(T_{z,1}) and B(T_{z,2})!`;
  } else if (x0 < 0) {
    ball.setAttribute('fill', '#20B2AA');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#20B2AA";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#20B2AA;"><b>✓ TELEVARIANT BASIN B(T_{z,1}) = (-∞, 0):</b></span> Ψ(x₀) = ${psi.toFixed(3)}, X_AR = -Ψ'(x₀) = ${(-grad).toFixed(2)}<br>` +
      `Trajectory flows exponentially to left Telezentrum <b>T_{z,1} = -1</b>!`;
  } else {
    ball.setAttribute('fill', '#FFD700');
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#FFD700";
    box.innerHTML = `<span style="color:#FFD700;"><b>✓ TELEVARIANT BASIN B(T_{z,2}) = (0, +∞):</b></span> Ψ(x₀) = ${psi.toFixed(3)}, X_AR = -Ψ'(x₀) = ${(-grad).toFixed(2)}<br>` +
      `Trajectory flows exponentially to right Telezentrum <b>T_{z,2} = +1</b>!`;
  }
}

function setTransStratum(m) {
  let cards = document.getElementById('trans-cards');
  let box = document.getElementById('trans-readout');

  let cLeft = `
    <div style="background:rgba(65,105,225,0.15); border:1.5px solid #4169E1; border-radius:8px; padding:10px;">
      <b style="color:#82aaff;">Stratum C(${m}) := Coalg(T_${m})</b><hr style="border-color:#2d3748; margin:6px 0;">
      <div style="color:#FFD700; font-weight:bold;">★ Haupttelezentrum: νT_${m}</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.9em; color:#cbd5e1;">Absolute Terminal Coalgebra Goal of Stratum C(${m})</div>
    </div>`;

  let cRight = `
    <div style="background:rgba(32,178,170,0.15); border:1.5px solid #20B2AA; border-radius:8px; padding:10px;">
      <b style="color:#5eead4;">Stratum C(${m+1}) := Coalg(T_${m+1})</b><hr style="border-color:#2d3748; margin:6px 0;">
      <div style="color:#FFA500; font-weight:bold;">↳ Nebentelezentrum: Γ_${m}(νT_${m}) ≅ HypMet_${m+1}</div>
      <div style="color:#FFD700; font-weight:bold; margin-top:4px;">★ New Higher Goal: νT_${m+1} ≇ Γ_${m}(νT_${m})</div>
    </div>`;

  cards.innerHTML = cLeft + cRight;
  box.innerHTML =
    `<b>Transzendenzsynkolator Adjunction (Γ_${m} ⊣ U_${m+1}, Thm. 6.19):</b> ` +
    `The terminal attractor <b>νT_${m}</b> of C(${m}) is demoted by left adjoint Γ_${m} into the initial generating building block <b>HypMet_${m+1}</b> on the way to <b>νT_${m+1}</b>!`;
}

function updateKramers() {
  let de = parseFloat(document.getElementById('kr-de').value);
  let eps = parseFloat(document.getElementById('kr-eps').value);
  document.getElementById('kr-de-val').innerText = de.toFixed(2);
  document.getElementById('kr-eps-val').innerText = eps.toFixed(2);

  let ratio = de / eps;
  let tauSurv = Math.exp(ratio);
  let box = document.getElementById('kr-readout');

  if (ratio < 2.0) {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#DC143C";
    box.innerHTML =
      `<span style="color:#ff6b81;"><b>⚠ METASTABLE EXTINCTION RISK (ΔE / ε_fluct = ${ratio.toFixed(2)} &lt; 2.0):</b></span><br>` +
      `Eyring–Kramers Survival Time τ_surv ∝ exp(ΔE/ε) = <b>${tauSurv.toFixed(1)} steps</b>. Imminent dysvariant escape across D_ext! Click <b>Trigger Resynkolation</b>!`;
  } else {
    box.style.borderLeftColor = "#20B2AA";
    box.innerHTML =
      `<span style="color:#20B2AA;"><b>✓ TELEVARIANTLY STABILIZED BASIN (ΔE / ε_fluct = ${ratio.toFixed(2)} ≥ 2.0):</b></span><br>` +
      `Eyring–Kramers Mean Survival Time τ_surv ∝ exp(ΔE/ε) = <b style="color:#FFD700;">${tauSurv > 1000 ? tauSurv.toExponential(2) : tauSurv.toFixed(1)} steps</b> (Protected against thermal escape).`;
  }
}

function triggerResynkolation() {
  document.getElementById('kr-de').value = 2.6;
  document.getElementById('kr-eps').value = 0.30;
  updateKramers();
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  updateStage5();
  initDoubleWellCurve();
  updateDoubleWell();
  setTransStratum(0);
  updateKramers();
});
</script>
